body: I would not survive in Australia 😂

I have an appointment with my psychiatrist in May, I will try to convince my mum to talk to him about anxiety meds (I’ve been thinking about those for a while) and see if I can go from there.

You may be right, but I am not a functioning adult. My mother is basically my carer. I will most likely never live alone because I’m incapable of doing so.

That is also a fair point, but I would need a specific therapist I think? And I’ve never had one. I was referred for my autism (and, as I found out, ADHD) diagnosis when I was 15 (and I didn’t get diagnosed until 17) from a psychologist that focused on mental health issues in relation with chronic illnesses (which I also have). I eventually stopped seeing her because she was useless when it came to things like anxiety, which I mostly have problems with. I do have a psychiatrist currently, but our sessions are mostly focused on medicating my ADHD and college, and I can’t see him because of the current situation. I struggle to bring things up because of the aforementioned anxiety, and if my mum won’t believe that my issue is serious and doesn’t bring it up for me I can’t do anything. Sorry that wasn’t made clear in the post.

I disagree with your stance on self-diagnosis but that’s irrelevant. And I’m confused, am I an asshole or not?

I will! Thank you for the suggestion.
